name: bluetooth-pedometer
description: Ultra-low-power CC2340R5 Bluetooth pedometer built with tscircuit

scripts.build: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --all-images --pcb-png --schematic-png --svgs --autorouter-timeout 15m && bun run check:artifact && tsci check shorts dist/index/circuit.json
scripts.snapshot:update: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci snapshot index.circuit.tsx --update
scripts.check:artifact: bun -e 'import { runAllRoutingChecks, checkEachPcbPortConnectedToPcbTraces } from "@tscircuit/checks"; const c = await Bun.file(process.argv[1] ?? "dist/index/circuit.json").json(); const checked = [...await runAllRoutingChecks(c), ...checkEachPcbPortConnectedToPcbTraces(c)]; const seen = new Set(); const errors = [...c, ...checked].filter(x => x.type.includes("error")).filter(x => { const key = x.type + ":" + x.message; if (seen.has(key)) return false; seen.add(key); return true; }); if (errors.length) { console.error(`${errors.length} circuit errors or disconnected ports remain`); for (const x of errors) console.error(`${x.type}: ${x.message ?? ""}`); process.exit(1); } console.log("Circuit artifact: all native routing checks pass and all required ports are connected");'
